raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Fixes #43273.

`Glm47MoeDetector`'s streaming path passed `array` / `object` / `boolean` argument values through verbatim, assuming the model wrote valid JSON, while non-streaming runs the same values through `parse_arguments`. When the model writes a value that isn't strict JSON, non-streaming returns valid arguments but streaming emits invalid JSON:

| param type | model wrote | non-streaming | streaming (main) |
|---|---|---|---|
| array | `1, 2` | `[1, 2]` | `1, 2` ❌ |
| boolean | `True` | `true` | `True` ❌ |
| array / object | (empty) | `""` | (nothing → `{"a": }`) ❌ |

## Modifications

`glm47_moe_detector.py`:
- Array/object values still stream verbatim, but only once the value opens with `[` / `{` (leading whitespace is held and emitted with the opener). Real JSON containers, such as long todo lists, keep streaming incrementally exactly as before.
- Any other value for a non-string type (`1, 2`, `True`, any boolean, an empty value) is held and parsed when `</arg_value>` arrives, through the same `_parse_argument_pairs` call already used for `auto` / `number` / `integer`. Streaming output now matches non-streaming for these values.
- `_format_value_complete` now only receives strings, so it drops the dead non-string branch.
- Once an array/object value has opened as JSON and is streaming, its content is no longer also appended to `_current_value` (the value-close path doesn't read it). Only values still being held are buffered. This lines up with #43729, which removes the same copy for values that stream through.

Known limitation, unchanged by this PR: a Python-style dict such as `{'a': 1}` opens with `{` and still streams verbatim. Handling it would mean buffering every object value, giving up incremental streaming.

Tests: `test_glm47_schema_types.py::test_non_json_container_and_boolean_values_stream_as_json` uses the existing `check_arguments` helper (non-streaming, plus streaming at chunk sizes 1, 7 and full) for `1, 2`, `True`, and whitespace-padded real JSON containers (a guard that verbatim streaming still works). The `1, 2` and `True` cases fail on main and pass with this change.

Extra check (not committed): a grid of array/object/boolean/string/number values × chunk sizes 1, 2, 3, 5, 7 and whole, comparing streamed and non-streamed arguments. On main, 36 of 132 streamed outputs are invalid JSON. With this change, all 132 are valid JSON and equal to non-streaming.

Related: #43270 (GLM-4.7 `parse_arguments` tuple fix) touches different lines of the same files; the two branches merge cleanly in either order. `Glm4MoeDetector` (GLM-4.5) has a similar streaming pattern, plus verbatim `number` streaming, and isn't changed here (noted in #43273).

## Accuracy Tests

N/A: parser-only change, no change to model forward or kernels.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

N/A. Values that open as JSON take the same path as before; other non-string values are buffered until `</arg_value>`, as numbers already are.

## Tests run

CPU-only (Python 3.13, torch 2.14.1+cpu, Linux container):

```
python -m pytest test/registered/unit/function_call/
630 passed, 1641 subtests passed
```

After the follow-up commit (no buffering of streamed containers), on Windows with CPU torch: `test_glm47_schema_types.py` 13 passed (666 subtests), GLM cases in `test_function_call_parser.py` 36 passed. The new `test_streamed_container_values_are_not_buffered` fails on the previous commit and passes now.

`pre-commit run --files <changed files>`: all hooks pass.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to pre-commit.
- [x] Add unit tests (bug regression; fails on main, passes with the fix).
- [ ] Update documentation (N/A).
- [ ] Accuracy/speed benchmarks (N/A, parser-only).

AI assistance: this change was prepared with an AI coding assistant (Claude Code). I reviewed every line and ran the tests above.

cc @JustinTong0323 (function_call code owner)

nodes.body: Hi @JustinTong0323, could you add `run-ci` (or `/tag-run-ci-label`) here as well when you get a chance? Small GLM-4.7 streaming tool-parser fix for #43273; lint passes and the function_call unit tests pass locally. Same request as on #43270.

Hi @JustinTong0323, could you add the `run-ci` label and review when you have a moment? This fixes GLM-4.7/5 tool-call streaming so non-JSON array/object/boolean values come out as valid JSON. #43270 is a companion fix to the same detector, so it may be easiest to review them together. Thanks!

@JustinTong0323 @ispobock friendly bump. When `stream=True`, GLM-4.7/5 tool calls can come out as invalid JSON (`1, 2` instead of `[1, 2]`, or `True` instead of `true`). The same request without streaming works. In my test grid in #43273, 36 of 132 streamed outputs were invalid on main. Most agent frameworks run `json.loads` on the arguments, so the tool call fails outright. An independent user has also reproduced it (see #43273). Could one of you add `run-ci` and take a look? I'm happy to rebase or split it if that's easier. #43729 touches the same branch, and the overlap is explained in my comment there.

Gentle ping for review. Both fixes are covered by the added tests (streamed tool arguments are now valid JSON in all 132 cases, previously 36 failed). I can rebase on main if anything has moved. Could a maintainer add the run-ci label so CI can run? Thanks!

files.patch:
@@ -20,6 +20,8 @@
 
 logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
 
+_JSON_OPENERS = {"array": "[", "object": "{"}
+
 
 @lru_cache(maxsize=1)
 def _glm47_native_structural_tag_available() -> bool:
@@ -406,12 +408,9 @@ def _get_value_type(self, func_name: str, key: str, tools: List[Tool]) -> str:
         return get_argument_type(func_name, key, tools) or "auto"
 
     def _format_value_complete(self, value: str, value_type: str) -> str:
-        """Format a value that completed in one chunk; number/integer/auto never
-        reach here (they are parsed at value close instead)."""
-        if value_type == "string":
-            return json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False)
-        # object/array/boolean values arrive as JSON already
-        return value
+        """Format a string value that never started streaming; every other
+        type that never started is parsed at value close instead."""
+        return json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False)
 
     def _process_xml_to_json_streaming(
         self, raw_increment: str, func_name: str, tools: List[Tool]
@@ -468,7 +467,9 @@ def _process_xml_to_json_streaming(
                     self._current_value += final_value
 
                     value_type = self._cached_value_type or "string"
-                    if value_type in ("auto", "number", "integer"):
+                    if value_type in ("auto", "number", "integer") or (
+                        value_type != "string" and not self._value_started
+                    ):
                         parsed = self._parse_argument_pairs(
                             [(self._current_key, self._current_value)], func_name, tools
                         )[self._current_key]
@@ -518,13 +519,22 @@ def _process_xml_to_json_streaming(
                                 self._current_value += content
                                 self._xml_tag_buffer = ""
                         else:
-                            # object/array/boolean values stream through verbatim
+                            # Object/array values that open as JSON stream through
+                            # verbatim; anything else ("1, 2", "True") is held and
+                            # parsed at value close, as non-streaming does.
                             if content:
-                                if not self._value_started:
-                                    self._value_started = True
-                                json_output += content
-                                self._current_value += content
                                 self._xml_tag_buffer = ""
+                                if self._value_started:
+                                    # Emitted content is not read at value close.
+                                    json_output += content
+                                else:
+                                    self._current_value += content
+                                    if self._current_value.lstrip()[
+                                        :1
+                                    ] == _JSON_OPENERS.get(value_type):
+                                        self._value_started = True
+                                        json_output += self._current_value
+                                        self._current_value = ""
 
         return json_output

@@ -264,6 +264,65 @@ def test_numeric_prefix_does_not_commit_to_invalid_json(self):
             {"value": "123abc"},
         )
 
+    def test_non_json_container_and_boolean_values_stream_as_json(self):
+        """Streaming passed array/object/boolean values through verbatim, so a
+        value that isn't JSON ("1, 2", "True") produced invalid JSON while
+        non-streaming parsed it."""
+        schema = {
+            "type": "object",
+            "properties": {
+                "ids": {"type": "array"},
+                "flag": {"type": "boolean"},
+                "opts": {"type": "object"},
+            },
+        }
+        self.check_arguments(schema, {"ids": [1, 2]}, raw_values={"ids": "1, 2"})
+        self.check_arguments(schema, {"flag": True}, raw_values={"flag": "True"})
+        self.check_arguments(
+            schema,
+            {"ids": [1, 2], "opts": {"a": 1}},
+            raw_values={"ids": "\n[1, 2]\n", "opts": ' {"a": 1}'},
+        )
+
+    def test_streamed_container_values_are_not_buffered(self):
+        """Once an array/object value opens as JSON it streams through, so the
+        detector must not also keep a copy of it."""
+        for value_type, value in (
+            ("array", list(range(64))),
+            ("object", {str(i): i for i in range(32)}),
+        ):
+            with self.subTest(value_type=value_type):
+                schema = {
+                    "type": "object",
+                    "properties": {"value": {"type": value_type}},
+                }
+                tools = [
+                    Tool(
+                        type="function",
+                        function=Function(name="inspect", parameters=schema),
+                    )
+                ]
+                raw = " " + json.dumps(value)
+                detector = Glm47MoeDetector()
+                calls = list(
+                    detector.parse_streaming_increment(
+                        "<tool_call>inspect<arg_key>value</arg_key><arg_value>", tools
+                    ).calls
+                )
+                for offset in range(0, len(raw), 7):
+                    calls.extend(
+                        detector.parse_streaming_increment(
+                            raw[offset : offset + 7], tools
+                        ).calls
+                    )
+                    self.assertEqual(detector._current_value, "")
+                for char in "</arg_value></tool_call>":
+                    calls.extend(detector.parse_streaming_increment(char, tools).calls)
+                self.assertEqual(
+                    json.loads("".join(call.parameters for call in calls)),
+                    {"value": value},
+                )
+
